### ① Derived judgments

- **DELIBERATE CORRECTION — confirmed.** The note is `.changeset/37150-docs-pages-in-app-shell.md`, #37193's pending (unreleased) changeset, its last paragraph. Before: "The `/docs` portal is not changed by this release." After: "The `/docs` portal draws in the same frame from 768 px up too, in a variant that belongs to no app (its own entry describes it)." The old sentence would be false once this PR lands: from 768 px up, `App.tsx` `DocsPortalRoute` now mounts `DocsPortalShell` instead of `DefaultHomeLayout variant="docs"`. I judge the new sentence TRUE to the code at this head, clause by clause:
  - "the same frame": `DesktopDocsPortalShell` mounts the same `AppShell` (`showHeader={false}`, `navbar={null}`) and `UnifiedSidebar` an app's docs pages use. In `docsPortal` mode `shellChrome` is on, so the head has the collapse button, search (when a palette is mounted) and `InboxBell`, and the foot has `AccountMenu`. `ShellPageActionsScope sidebarExpand appless` gives the page header's assistant and help group and the expand button. Those are the parts the 37150 note itself lists as the frame: no top bar, the sidebar's head and foot, and the page header's button group.
  - "from 768 px up": `usePhoneViewport` is `innerWidth < 768` (`PHONE_BELOW_WIDTH`). Below that, `DocsPortalShell` returns `HomeLayout variant="docs"`, the same element the route mounted before. So the note's phone sentence ("a phone keeps its app bar…") is still true.
  - "belongs to no app": the context is set to `home`, nothing writes a current or last app, and `AppShell` gets no `branding`, so its effect removes `--primary`/`--accent`. The head is `SidebarDocsPortalMenu`, with no row checked, and the help group is `HelpMenu inApp={false}` with no package.
  - "(its own entry describes it)": `.changeset/37197-docs-portal-app-less-shell.md` is added in the same PR.
  - No other sentence in the note is made false: every docs address keeps its route (`App.tsx` swaps only the frame element), and the app docs column keeps its parts. The column's order is now described by the 37197 entry, and the 37150 parenthesis is a list of parts, not an order.
  - The portal's standing banners are drawn above the shell rather than in its content area. That is covered in the seat's L1 at this head. It is not part of what the 37150 note calls the frame, so it does not make the sentence false.
- `Clause-②: no` holds. No `packages/spec/src/**` path is touched, and nothing in any package's `exports` is removed or narrowed. `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true` with `exports` `.` only, and its barrel gains `DocsPortalShell` and `DocsPortalShellProps` (additive). `HomeCommandPalette` and `SidebarDocsPortalMenu` are exported from their modules only, not from the barrel.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` holds. No metadata key, value or type is added, removed or changed in meaning, and the UI reads only existing app fields (`name`, `label`, `_packageId`, `navigation`, `areas`).
- i18n: no locale file is touched, so no 18.6.0 key is removed and nothing is owed under ruling 7153171432 / 7153326968. Each new `t()` key resolves at head in `en` and `zh-Hans`.

### ② Semver level

`patch` on `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console` and `@objectstack/console`, in both notes, is correct for a non-protocol, additive UI change. The CI `check-changeset-no-major` LEVEL AXIS reads `no` / `none` at patch and finds no major. The `Check Changeset` red on both runs at this head is the DELIBERATE CORRECTION refusal (job 139030845608: ".changeset/37150-docs-pages-in-app-shell.md exists on the merge base and was not added by this PR…"), which this record confirms. It is not a level failure.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The dev flags, each answered:
  - (a) Book labels in an app's own docs column still use `usePackageDocsNavBooks`' label. The approved scope was the portal tree, so this is correctly left as noted.
  - (b) The `overlap-check` modify/delete against #35129 (Version Packages) is the expected meeting of the correction with the bot PR. It was not resolved by hand.
  - (c) Home's palette host app is read and never written. This is search scope, as on Home and in the old portal frame, and no frame app comes from it.
- No open questions remain on this head.
- SQL push-down: the diff only changes client UI. It adds no id materialisation and no in-app join over server data; `groupBooksByApp` groups the already-served book index in memory, as the index page already does. Nothing to record.
- The author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay).
- This record covers this head only. The seat's L1 at this head asks for a rework, and any fix moves the head, so this record does not carry over to the new head.

The fix is to add a pin in `DocsPortalShell-37197`, which already mounts the real `AppShell`: open the portal after an app with `branding.primaryColor`, assert that `document.documentElement.style` carries no `--primary`, and add a phone control.
- S2 (should-fix) — The portal's desktop frame has no content-area banner host. This was found by reading the code; I did not render it.
  - `ConsoleLayout` mounts `ChromeBannerHost` (and `ConnectionBanner`) in `console-banners` from 768 px up. `DocsPortalShell` does not.
  - So the standing banners (impersonation, read-rate, storage) stay in `ConsoleShell`'s `ChromeBannerSlot` above the route, at full window width.
  - Meanwhile the shell's sidebar is `fixed inset-y-0` from the window's top. The impersonation banner is `sticky top-0 z-50`, so it covers the sidebar's head row (the 「文档」 menu and the collapse button). The in-flow storage and read-rate banners run under the sidebar's column.

  - The fix: mount the host, inside a non-shrinking box at the top of the portal's content as `ConsoleLayout` does, with a 1440 pin and a phone control. Narrowing the doc sentence alone would leave the overlap.
- S3 (should-fix) — The 37197 note's opening sentence is false at head. It says the portal "was the last desktop page that still drew a top bar". In fact `/organizations` (`OrganizationsLayout`, `AppHeader variant="orgs"`) and Home's no-product-app state (`HomeRoute` → `RootLandingRedirect home={page}`, `DefaultHomeLayout`) still draw a top bar from 768 px up. Reword it, e.g. "was the one documentation page that still drew a top bar on a desktop".
- N1 — The 37197 note says "the sidebar with search and notifications in its head". Search is drawn only while a palette is mounted (`docsPortalSearch={!!hostApp}`), so a workspace with no openable app gets no search field. The PR body discloses this; the note could say "search (when there is an app to search)".
- N2 — The `rememberApp` assertions in `DocsPortalShell-37197` guard a mocked hook that nothing in the portal's tree calls. The last-app-key storage check is what carries the "no app remembered" pin.

  - The pin is the new block "the portal takes no app's brand". It seeds `--primary`/`--accent` on the root, opens the portal after `crm`, which has a mocked `branding.primaryColor`, and expects neither variable.
